name: The Flying Dutchman
description: The Flying Dutchman (German: Fliegender Holländer; English: The Flying Dutchman. Also translated as the Wandering Dutchman, the Wandering Dutchman, the Flying Dutchman, etc.) is a legendary ghost ship that can never return home and is destined to drift and sail on the sea. The Flying Dutchman is usually spotted at a distance, sometimes with a ghostly glow. It is said that if she was hailed by another ship, her crew would try to send someone to deliver a message to someone on land or long dead. In maritime lore, an encounter with this ghost ship was seen by sailors as a portent of doom. In German (fliegend), it is used to express a state of continuous flight, describing the tragic fate of the cursed Dutch people who are forever drifting on the sea, sailing around, but never reaching the shore.
